content.short: Realio is a RWA-focused Layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK for secure institutional-grade digital securities.
content.description: Realio Network is a premier decentralized Layer 1 ecosystem engineered specifically for the issuance and management of digitally native real-world assets (RWAs). Built using the Cosmos SDK and being fully EVM-compatible, the network provides institutional-grade infrastructure for tokenizing high-value assets such as real estate and private equity. The ecosystem utilizes a unique dual-token system: $RIO for network gas and utility, and $RST as a digital security token that represents equity in the Realio platform. By leveraging the interoperability of Cosmos IBC, Realio delivers a scalable environment.
content.meta: Realio Network provides a specialized Layer 1 blockchain for the tokenization of RWAs. Discover Realio and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
